subject: Trading
title: Generating Income with Options
description: Learn Generating Income with Options in one minute.

hook.text: Some retirees sell covered calls every month, generating 1-2% income on their portfolios. Options as a paycheck.

buildup.text: Selling premium—covered calls, cash-secured puts—creates regular income from stocks you already own or want to own.

discovery.text: A cash-secured put means you sell a put and set aside cash to buy the stock if assigned. You get paid to wait for a dip.

twist.text: Income strategies work consistently until a crash. Then the sold puts get assigned at painfully high prices.

climax.text: Options income isn't free money—it's compensation for accepting risk. The premium is your payment for being the insurer.

punchline.text: You get paid for risk. Make sure the pay is worth it.

quiz.question: What is a cash-secured put?
options: Buying a put with only cash accounts
Selling a put while holding cash to buy the stock if assigned
Putting cash in a savings account
